en.headline: Four residents colonised by CPE at Wan Chai nursing home
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating a cluster of carbapenemase-producing Enterobacteriaceae at Green Mountain Home; infection-control lapses are suspected to have allowed spread within the facility.
body: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating a cluster of carbapenemase-producing Enterobacteriaceae colonisation involving four residents of Green Mountain Home, a nursing home in Wan Chai. The residents, aged 73 to 90, remain in stable condition and have shown no symptoms of infection.

The centre was notified by the Hospital Authority that two residents from the same floor had tested positive for CPE on admission screening after being hospitalised for other illnesses. Contact tracing and screening identified two further colonised residents.

Epidemiological investigation suggests the source may have been another previously known colonised resident on the same floor who had acquired the organism in hospital. A site inspection found that the home had not fully implemented the required infection-prevention and control measures, raising the possibility that the bacteria spread via staff or contaminated surfaces.

The centre has reminded the home to strengthen hand hygiene, environmental cleaning and disinfection, and to cohort colonised residents. Screening of remaining residents continues and medical surveillance of the home remains in place.

zh.headline: 灣仔綠山居護老院四院友帶產碳青霉烯酶腸道桿菌
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心調查綠山居護老院產碳青霉烯酶腸道桿菌帶菌群組，四名73至90歲院友情況穩定，院舍未妥善執行感染控制措施。
body: 衞生防護中心正調查灣仔綠山居護老院的產碳青霉烯酶腸道桿菌帶菌個案群組，涉及四名院友，年齡介乎73至90歲，現時情況穩定。
中心近月接獲醫管局通知，指該安老院同一樓層有兩名院友因自身疾病入住公立醫院，入院篩查樣本經化驗後證實帶有產碳青霉烯酶腸道桿菌，懷疑在該院舍受到感染。中心隨即展開流行病學調查及接觸者追蹤及篩查，發現另外兩宗帶菌個案。四名病人均屬帶菌者，沒有出現相關病徵。
調查發現這四名近期帶菌者的感染源頭可能來自該院舍同一樓層早前已知的另外一名在醫院感染的帶菌者。巡查發現該院舍未有妥善執行相關的傳染病預防及控制措施，不排除細菌透過員工或被污染的環境在院內傳播。
中心已提醒院舍必須跟從指引執行所需措施，包括確保有足夠潔手設施、加強手部衞生、徹底清潔及消毒環境，並建議集中安置帶菌者。中心會繼續在院舍篩查，以確定有否其他帶菌者，並繼續對該安老院進行醫學監察。
